text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aww, so frustrating, I couldn't win. Turbo 
was amazing, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win next time. Yeah, I have to 
work even harder."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Speak of the devil!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I beat Machitan~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, look at them tearing off at 
incredible speed—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, wasn't the station the other way!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "T-Turbo! Wait a minute~!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy, I'm happy, I'm happy! So 
haaaappy~~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Turbo, that way is Saitama!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I can't take it anymooore...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where is this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*, there you are! I lost sight of you 
for a sec and totally panicked!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The academy's not this way~! Totally the 
wrong direction!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's a bus stop over that way, so let's 
take the bus home!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I'm so glad Machitan is here, you 
scared me~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, there, there……!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, are you thirsty? There's juice.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
My throat... is parched! I'm gonna drink 
some juice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Matikane Tannhauser came 
carrying the exhausted, sleeping Twin 
Turbo on her back.
